episode: Family Room Makeover, Golf House pt 2
video_title: We Tore Off the Old Rock Fireplace | Family Room Remodel Before & After | The Golf House
assessment: Phase two at the Golf House: the family room had to match the navy kitchen from phase one. The rock and cobblestone fireplace with its big mantle came off, the fireplace was pulled out a couple of inches so the wall could be furred out, and the wall became navy built ins with oak tops, an oak mantle, shiplap and a honeycomb tile with gold inlay and no grout. There was no pre demo video, only one before photo at 0:40, so the before beat is that photo and everything else is the finished reveal from 6:15 to 8:05. The long video's hook is the rock coming off, so this Short leads on the tile instead.

project_context.summary: Golf House family room, phase two after the kitchen. Rock fireplace and mantle torn off, fireplace bumped out, navy built ins both sides, oak mantle and tops, shiplap, honeycomb tile with gold inlay, heat resistant gold paint on the fireplace, switched outlet on the mantle, new can lights, the dining light moved in where the fan was, new hardwood woven into the old.
project_context.segment_choice: One Short, a reveal tour. One before beat from the only before photo, then the finished wall.
project_context.publish_order: Long video first, then this Short with the long video set as its Related video.
notes: No workers, no construction in progress.
